```

rm(list = ls())
```

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LIBRARIES
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r Libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

### Load in the data
```{r Load in data, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
pdc_data <- read_csv(here("data", "cf_genomic_analysis_Pae_PDC.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

### Prepare data
```{r Prepare data, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
pdc_data <- pdc_data %>%
  mutate(
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0", "T3", "T6", "T9", "T12")),
    PatientID = factor(PatientID, levels = c("A7", "A19", "P3", "P11", "P42")),
    PDC = factor(PDC)
  )
```

### Plot sorted by PatientID
```{r Plot sorted, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
pdc_plot <- pdc_data %>%
  mutate(
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0", "T3", "T6", "T9", "T12")),
    PatientID = factor(PatientID, levels = c("A7", "A19", "P3", "P11", "P42")),
    PDC = as.character(PDC)
  ) %>%
  group_by(PatientID, Time) %>%
  summarise(
    PDC_label = paste(unique(PDC), collapse = "\n"),
    PDC_fill = ifelse(n_distinct(PDC) == 1, as.character(first(PDC)), "Mixed"),
    n_isolates = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    PatientID,
    Time,
    fill = list(
      PDC_label = "",
      PDC_fill = "No isolate",
      n_isolates = NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      PDC_label == "" ~ "",
      !is.na(n_isolates) & n_isolates > 1 ~ paste0(PDC_label, "\n(n=", n_isolates, ")"),
      TRUE ~ PDC_label
    ),
    PDC_fill = factor(
      PDC_fill,
      levels = c("PDC-3", "PDC-5", "PDC-8", "PDC-52", "PDC-53", "Mixed", "No isolate")
    )
  )

pdc_plot_sorted <- ggplot(pdc_plot, aes(x = Time, y = PatientID, fill = PDC_fill)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8, width = 0.9, height = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 4, color = "black") +
  scale_y_discrete(
    limits = rev(c("A7", "A19", "P3", "P11", "P42"))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "PDC-3"  = "#a6611a",  
      "PDC-5"  = "#dfc27d",  
      "PDC-8"  = "#c2a5cf",  
      "PDC-52" = "#80cdc1",  
      "PDC-53" = "#018571",  
      "Mixed" = "grey60",
      "No isolate" = "grey95"
    ),
    name = "PDC variant"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Participant"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = here("results", "Pae_PDC.svg"), plot = pdc_plot_sorted, width = 7,
  height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
